Trump is suing the federal government (himself!) for billions in payments (to himself!) and when the courts say no, he tells the parties (both him!) to settle.

Confusing? Let me explain.

5/ And - Trump withdrew from the WHO (where we could work on a global response), eliminated the office for pandemic response, and is proposing a 30% cut to the CDC. The CDC has also been without a permanent director for nearly 8 months. This all leaves us so vulnerable.

4/ Again, I don't want to be alarmist. Maybe this virus can't spread like COVID. But we don't know enough about it and last year, the Trump Admin killed funding to study hantavirus – one of many drastic cuts to infectious disease research.

apnews.com/article/hantaviru…

2/ After the WHO said they were investigating an outbreak, it took the CDC days to say anything publicly and that only came AFTER a news outlet reported Americans who were exposed on the cruise ship were back on U.S. soil.

Why was the response so slow?
medpagetoday.com/special-rep…

It's time to ask some questions about Trump's nonchalant response to the Hantavirus outbreak. 

1/ We hope this isn't another COVID. It looks less contagious. But the Admin needs to take it more seriously and address some big holes they created in our pandemic response system.

Trump did this. 

Everyone knew that a war with Iran would cause a global price crisis and he did it anyway, because as he told us yesterday, "I don't think about Americans' financial situation".

It's not complicated.

chrismurphyct.com/p/in-our-s…

2/ THE BALLROOM AND MICROCHIPS: It should be a national security priority to not sell our advanced AI chips to China. But the tech CEOs who have supported Trump's ballroom want him to agree at this summit to hand them over. Huge risk.

Trump's China summit could be a disaster. Why?

First, CORRUPTION (his billionaire backers want him to do deals that help them and hurt us).

Second, THE STRAIT (Trump could sell our our security to get China to help clean up his Iran mess).
